chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Husayn ibn Ulwan, from Amr ibn Khalid, from Zayd ibn Ali, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) cursed wine, and the one who squeezes it, and the one who orders it to be squeezed, and its seller, and its buyer, and its server, and the consumer of its price, and its drinker, and its carrier, and the one to whom it is carried.

key_terms.سَاقِيَهَا: The one who serves or pours it
key_terms.عَاصِرَهَا: The one who squeezes/presses it (for extraction)
key_terms.مُعْتَصِرَهَا: The one who orders or causes it to be squeezed

ai.seo_question: Who are the people cursed in relation to wine according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the comprehensive nature of the curse on wine by listing twelve distinct roles involved in its lifecycle, a classification often cited in Shia jurisprudence to establish the prohibition of all parties in the transaction chain. It underscores the concept of 'mutual cursing' among those who facilitate consumption, extending spiritual accountability beyond the individual drinker to include producers, traders, and servers. This enumeration reflects the Prophetic tradition's emphasis on eliminating the entire ecosystem of intoxicants to prevent their proliferation.
